simple.meaning: the heart (as the most interior organ);
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to לֵבָב (H3824) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 252 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: לֵבָב (lêbâb) means the heart (as the most interior organ); First listed occurrence: 1Chr 12 18.

definitions.short: the heart (as the most interior organ);
definitions.usage: bethink themselves, breast, comfortably, courage, ((faint), (tender-) heart(-ed), midst, mind, × unawares, understanding.
definitions.full: H3824. lebab לֵבָב 251 noun masculine Psa 104:15 inner man, mind, will, heart ; — absolute ׳ל Deut 28:28 31 t.; construct לִבַב 20:8 22t.; suffix לְבָבִי Isa 21:4 24t.; לְבָֽבְךָ Deut 4:29 35 t.; לְבָבֶ֑ךָ 4:39 21 t.; לְבָבֵךְ 1Sam 1:8 3 t.; לְבָבוֺ Deut 2:30 37 t.; לְבָבָהּ Zeph 2:15 3 t.; לִבָבֵנוּ Deut 1:28 3 t.; לְבַבְכֶם 10:16 37t.; לְבָבָם Lev 26:41 22 t.; plural with suffix לִבְבֵהֶן Nahum 2:8 (Sta § 353 a reads לְבַבְהֶן , but see Kö ii. 78 ); plural לְבָבוֺת 1Chr 28:9 . — The inner, middle, or central part: I. seldom of things יַמִּים בִּלְבַב in the Midst of the seas Jonah 2:3 (poetry); השׁמים לבב עד unto the midst of heaven Deut 4:11 (so ⅏ but לב ᵑ0 ). II. usually of men: 1 the inner man in contrast with the outer, ולבבי שׁארי כלה my flesh and my heart ( soul ) doth fail Psa 73:26 ; antithesis with garments Joel 2:13 ; hands Psa 73:13 ; Lam 3:41 ? ; eyes Num 15:39 (H) 1Sam 16:7 ; ears Ezek 3:10 ; mouth Deut 30:14 ; speech Psa 28:3 ; 78:18 ; עַללִֿבְבֵהֶן מְתֹפֲפֹת tabering upon their breasts Nahum 2:7 (inner for outer). 2 the inner man , indefinite the soul , comprehending mind, affections and will, or, in connection with certain verbs, having more specific reference to some one of them. ובכלנֿפשׁ בכללֿבב with all the heart and with all the soul Deut 4:29 ; 6:5 ; 10:12 ; 11:13 ; 13:4 ; 26:16 ; 30:2 , 6 , 10 ; Josh 22:5 ; 23:14 ; 1Kin 2:4 ; 8:48 (= 2Chr 6:38 לב ?) 2Kin 23:25 ; 2Chr 15:12 ; 34:31 ( = 2Kin 23:3 לב ?)
